title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.09802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. translated_title: 当指令文件过时：编码智能体中的文档债务与隐性成本
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的编码智能体（如Claude Code）由仓库中的指令文件（也称上下文文件或智能体配置文件，如AGENTS.md和CLAUDE.md）引导，这些文件在每次智能体会话中都会被读取。作为任何文档产物，这些文件可能落后于代码而变得过时（例如，测试文件夹被移动了，但文件仍指向旧位置）。用技术债务的术语来说，这种过时的指令就是文档债务，其“利息”是它给后续每次智能体会话增加的成本。仅检查任务成功与否的评估方式可能忽略这一成本，从而使过时文件得以持续存在。在本研究中，我们探究是什么导致智能体执行过时指令，它如何影响智能体的行为以及产生多大成本，以及智能体如何从中恢复。我们深入研究了来自活跃开源仓库的三个真实世界过时指令案例，每个代表一种不同类型的指引：一条测试命令、一个代码位置，以及一个添加组件的操作流程……
tldr: 该研究首次深入剖析了LLM编码智能体对仓库中过时指令文件（即“文档债务”）的响应行为，揭示了其在每次会话中产生的隐性成本及智能体的恢复机制。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first in-depth analysis of how LLM-based coding agents act on stale repository instruction files (documentation debt), revealing the hidden per-session costs they incur and how agents recover from them.
